speech.register: Rough, direct conversational English. Brief sentences and practical actions precede stories. Strength never means unlimited labor or insensitivity to pain.
speech.stage_relaxation: Practical silence opens into carrying shared loads, the number 417 in Drum, conscription and choosing the revolt, then asking for help and quiet company without surrendering her name.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.
